root_cause: Left join fanout: stg_customers has duplicate rows per customer_id, multiplying orders for those customers in order_customer_detail and violating unique order_id.
evidence: mart grain is one row per order_id from fct_orders left join stg_customers
unique test on order_id failed with 2 duplicate groups
row_count 12 with duplicate_rows 2 indicates row multiplication
join key is customer_id, fanout occurs if stg_customers not unique on customer_id
patch:
--- a/models/marts/order_customer_detail.sql
+++ b/models/marts/order_customer_detail.sql
@@ -1,10 +1,19 @@
+with stg_customers_deduped as (
+    select * from (
+        select c.*,
+               row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by signup_date desc) as _rn
+        from {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c
+    ) where _rn = 1
+)
 select
     o.order_id,
     o.customer_id,
     o.order_date,
     o.amount,
     o.status,
     c.email,
     c.full_name,
     c.region
 from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} o
-left join {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
+left join stg_customers_deduped c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
